title: LIKE search implemented with a parameterized query

pr_metadata.title: Partial account-number search
pr_metadata.body: LIKE with a bound parameter; wildcards in user input escaped.

expected.reference_review: Parameterized LIKE: the query text is constant and the pattern is bound as a value, with the driver handling quoting; user % is escaped to prevent wildcard injection (a correctness concern, not SQL injection). Counterpart of the SQLi case in this family; safe as written.
